mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide increases urinary magnesium excretion through inhibition of magnesium reabsorption in the distal convoluted tubule, potentially leading to hypomagnesemia.
action: Monitor serum magnesium levels periodically in patients on chronic hydrochlorothiazide therapy; consider magnesium supplementation if levels become depleted or if hypomagnesemia-related symptoms (muscle weakness, arrhythmias) develop.
